prompts.name: pizza
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single transparent desktop dock icon for a pizza delivery videogame. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for authentic Mac OS X 2007–2012 skeuomorphic application icon craft. Create ONE isolated icon: a small slightly open real kraft cardboard pizza box with a delicious round pepperoni pizza visible, sitting in front of an orange insulated courier bag, three-quarter view. Rich handcrafted realistic miniature illustration, physically believable corrugated cardboard, melted cheese, orange woven textile, polished little zipper. Consistent upper-left studio key light, detailed material shading, soft restrained contact shadow. Original game icon with the natural tangible object appearance of the reference, irregular silhouette. Center the whole icon generously within a square canvas, entire object visible, occupies 78% of image width/height. Actual transparent background. No rounded-square app tile, no colored backplate, no circle background, no UI, no border, no labels, no letters, no watermark. This icon must read very clearly at 96 pixels.
